# Fixture Conventions

## Tag Namespaces

| Namespace | Purpose | Values |
|-----------|---------|--------|
| `audience/*` | Who the note is for | `agent`, `human` |
| `type/*` | Kind of content | `meta`, `note` |
| `topic/*` | Subject matter | Free-form (e.g., `software`) |
| `workflow/*` | Lifecycle stage | `canonical`, `draft` |
| `status/*` | Actionability | `active` |
